headword: {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}

definitions.explanation: Detergent specifically formulated for washing clothes, available in liquid, powder, or pod form.

examples.japanese: {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: We've run out of laundry detergent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溶|と}け→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Liquid laundry detergent dissolves more easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use additive-free laundry detergent because I have sensitive skin.

notes:
USAGE:
{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} is the specific term for laundry detergent, as opposed to ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ which refers to detergent/cleanser in general (including dish soap, surface cleaner, etc.).

TYPES:
- ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (liquid detergent)
- ⟦{粉末|ふんまつ}→粉末：13772_funmatsu⟧{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (powdered detergent)
- ⟦{柔軟剤|じゅうなんざい}→柔軟剤：07034_juunanzai⟧{入|い}り{洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい} (detergent with fabric softener)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to add laundry detergent)
- {洗濯洗剤|せんたくせんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (the amount of detergent)
